sentences.text: 4. Heard learned advocates for the parties and perused the record.
5. The investigation is over and the charge-sheet is also filed.

The only role attributed to the present applicant in commission of crime in question is to the effect that he has acted as a broker between the co- accused - purchaser of the goods and the first informant.

As per the case of the prosecution,
first informant sold goods worth of Rs.30 Lakhs to the co- accused through the present applicant out of which sum of Rs.4/- Lakhs was paid and remaining amount was not paid.

Considering these facts and the nature of allegations and the fact that investigation is over and the charge-sheet is filed, the present application NEUTRAL CITATION R/CR.MA/8031/2023 ORDER DATED: 19/10/2023 undefined deserves consideration and accordingly stands allowed.

The Applicant Accused is ordered to be released on bail in connection with the FIR being CR.No.11191026220456 of 2022 registered with Kalupur Police Station, Dist.Ahmedabad on executing a personal bond of Rs.10,000/- with one surety of the like amount to the satisfaction of the trial Court, subject to the following conditions that the applicant shall:
(a) not directly or indirectly make any inducement, threat or promise to any person acquainted with the fact of the case so as to dissuade him from disclosing such facts to the Court or any Police Officer or tamper with the evidence.
(b) maintain law and order and not to indulge in any criminal activities.

(c) furnish the documentary proof of complete, correct and present address of residence to the Investigating Officer and to the Trial Court at the time of executing the bond NEUTRAL CITATION R/CR.MA/8031/2023 ORDER DATED: 19/10/2023 undefined and shall not change the residence without prior permission of the trial Court.
(d) provide contact numbers as well as the contact numbers of the sureties before the Trial Court.
In case of change in such numbers inform in writing immediately to the trial Court.
(e) file an affidavit stating his immovable properties whether self acquired or ancestral with description, location and present value of such properties before the Trial Court, if any.
(f) not leave India without prior permission of the Trial Court (g) surrender passport, if any, to the Trial Court within a week.
If the Applicant do not possess passport, shall file an Affidavit to that effect.
6. Bail bond to be executed before the Trial Court having jurisdiction to try the case.
It would be open NEUTRAL CITATION R/CR.MA/8031/2023 ORDER DATED: 19/10/2023 undefined for the Trial Court concerned to give time to furnish the solvency certificate if prayed for.
